reviews.text: Aleo is a layer-1 blockchain for private apps using zk-proofs. Launched in 2024, it uses the Leo language for privacy. In 2025, it’s used in DeFi and gaming. Strongly funded. Privacy-focused.

Aleo is a Layer-1 blockchain built for full privacy. It uses zero-knowledge proofs (via its snarkVM and Leo language) to run smart contracts confidentially with inputs, outputs and state hidden on-chain, trying to reach its goal of privacy by default. Aleo’s mainnet was launched in September 2024 after years of development. Aleo shows high community participation and commitment as around 69% of tokens are staked with around 10.8% APY, with hundreds of private programs deployed.

Aleo is a Zero Knowledge Proofs based layer 1 blockchain built using the Leo programming language. The protocol aims to offer a developer platform where applications are private, scalable and fully programmable right from the base. Aleo comes with snarkVM (Zero-Knowledge Virtual Machine) which is the execution environment for Aleo programs. It processes computations off-chain, requiring only the proof of execution to be sent to the network.
It also uses snarkOS which is the operating system that powers the Aleo network, validating transactions with a single proof of execution. The protocol uses AleoBFT, a hybrid consensus mechanism that comprises PoS for validators and PoW for provers for validating transactions on the network.
The project was founded by an experienced team that has an excellent academic background backed by large funding from top tier VCs like a16z, SoftBank Vision Fund, Tiger Global, and Samsung Next.Aleo has strong partnerships with prominent firms like Google cloud, Paxos Labs and  Global Dollar Network. Moreover, Aleo has multiple third party audits which are outdated for me in addition to the active bug bounty program in order to secure the protocol. In my opinion Aleo has good fundamentals but there is a need for more focus on more security measures like regular third party up to date audits.

Aleo is on my radar mainly for privacy: it uses SNARKs to let you run private smart contracts. I think that’s fascinating complete data confidentiality. I respect that focus, but personally it feels more like a research project currently. The tech is complex, execution is slow since some operations are off chain, and I haven’t seen real apps built on it yet. It’s an ambitious approach, but it still seems early and niche.

The project can be described as the Blockchain built for payments, it provides some level of privacy to its transactions and makes it possible for its integration and the development of other platforms or projects that are privacy related. It made available tools to achieve this. It adopts an open Blockchain, secured by zero knowledge proofs.

Aleo is a next generation blockchain platform designed to prioritize privacy and scalability. Using zero knowledge proofs (ZKPs), Aleo allows developers to build decentralized applications (dApps) while ensuring that users’ data remains private and secure. The platform aims to revolutionize the way data is handled on blockchains by enabling private computations and transactions without compromising on security. As a Layer-1 solution, Aleo’s innovative use of ZKPs positions it as one of the most promising blockchain projects for privacy focused applications.
